title: Add Binary
statement_short: Given two binary strings a and b, return their sum as a binary string.
constraints: 1 <= a.length, b.length <= 10^4, a and b consist only of '0' or '1' characters, no leading zeros except '0' itself
hint: String length up to 10^4 permits single-pass right-to-left addition using bit sums and carry handling.
why_not: Right: Math / Geometry applies digit-by-digit column addition with carry propagation from right to left in O(max(N, M)) time. Not Bit Manipulation: Converting binary strings to integers for bitwise operations overflows standard integer limits when length reaches 10^4\. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointers track character positions, but column carry arithmetic is basic math. Not Stack: Pushing digits to a stack handles reversal, but adding from tail pointers directly avoids extra stack allocation.
complexity: O(max(N, M)) time, O(max(N, M)) space
